s.note: a whole day sitting on the porch
s.how: Dice 4 tomatoes, half a white onion and a jalapeno. Mix with chopped coriander, the juice of a lime and salt. Leave for 10 minutes so the juices come out. Serve in a bowl with a big pile of corn chips on the front porch.

Cut 4 small slits around the edge of 8 thick bologna slices so they stay flat. Fry in a hot pan until crisp and curled at the edges. Lay a slice of American cheese on each, then pile into slider buns with yellow mustard.

m.how: Season 800g flathead fillets and dredge in fine cornmeal. Fry at 180C for 4 minutes until crisp. Serve with slices of white bread, hot sauce, fries baked from 1kg potatoes and a quick coleslaw of shredded cabbage and mayo.

w.note: a classic for the whole family
w.how: Whisk 750ml milk, 3 yolks, 150g sugar and 4 tbsp cornflour over heat until thick. Layer warm with sliced bananas and vanilla wafers in a dish. Chill overnight so the wafers soften, then top with whipped cream just before serving.

d.note: the cold drinks out on the porch
d.how: Mix 1L cranberry juice and 1L pineapple juice in a big jug. Top up with 1L cold lemonade just before serving so it stays fizzy. Pour over plenty of ice in big plastic cups and sit on the porch for the afternoon.
